# Keep store commit tokens separate from database-header changes

Bug 1958052 introduces folder-and-stream write methods that do not take nsIMsgDBHdr. The caller obtains a stream, writes bytes, then finishes or discards it; finish returns a store token for the caller to store on its header. The temporary 2 suffix is removed later in fixed accepted source. Mbox explicitly calls nsISafeOutputStream.Finish before returning its captured offset token; Maildir closes and moves the temporary file into cur before its normal token return. Maildir also has an already-moved-file success branch that returns before assigning the output token, so this inspection does not claim every successful branch produces a nonempty token. The added tests check round-trip bytes, explicit discard, one current stream per folder and independent folders. They do not inject failures or write partial bytes to the stream before the preemption case. No storage test ran.

Scope: Message-store write completion.
